name: moods
//: A row of faces, and the order is the sound: the low end is where a record thumps, so it wears the heaviest expression, and the top of the range — the cymbals and the sparkle — wears the brightest. The one in the middle used to have no mouth at all, which at this size reads as a face with something missing rather than as a face keeping its counsel.
//heights: The dot heights a mark is baked at, and the stroke it comes out with at each. See cmd/spindle-marks.
